name: Pahang Marathon 2026
short_description: A full and half marathon event held on September 6, 2026, at Dataran Sayangi Kuantan in Kuantan, Pahang, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Pahang Marathon 2026 is a road race scheduled for September 6, 2026, at Dataran Sayangi Kuantan in Kuantan, Pahang, Malaysia. It offers both a full marathon (42.195km) and a half marathon (21.1km) distance for participants to choose from. The event is organized by Persatuan Orang Muda Pahang KL (POMPKL) and Kita Pelari Malaysia, in partnership with Pure Events. Registration for the race is currently open.

core_facts.organizer: Persatuan Orang Muda Pahang KL (POMPKL) & Kita Pelari Malaysia, with Pure Events

pros: Offers a choice of two distances: full marathon (42.195km) and half marathon (21.1km)
Registration is currently open, allowing ample time to plan and prepare
Held at a named, central venue (Dataran Sayangi Kuantan) in Kuantan, Pahang
Backed by multiple organizing bodies, including POMPKL, Kita Pelari Malaysia, and Pure Events
research_highlights: This is the inaugural edition of the Pahang Marathon, explicitly billed by organizers as the event's debut in Kuantan on September 6, 2026
Race categories include 42KM Full Marathon and 21KM Half Marathon, each split into Men's and Women's Veteran (40yrs & above Malaysian) divisions, based on Race Roster registration listings

The event is co-organised by Persatuan Orang Muda Pahang KL (POMPKL) and Kita Pelari Malaysia, with Pure Events and Persatuan Olahraga Pahang as Technical Organisers, supported by Majlis Bandaraya Kuantan (MBK)
Event is open to all Malaysian residents and permitted non-Malaysian residents aged 5 and above, per the official rules and regulations
Race kit collection requires participants to bring a confirmation slip or NRIC/Passport for verification, and kits will not be issued after the designated collection period
research_watchouts: As a brand-new debut event with no prior edition, there are no participant race reports, reviews, or community discussion available yet to assess course conditions, crowd support, or organisation quality

A related same-organiser event, the Pahang Half Marathon 2025, was also marketed as a 'first ever' debut in Kuantan, but no post-race participant feedback from that edition was found in available sources

faqs.question: When is the Pahang Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Pahang Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026. The event will be held at Dataran Sayangi Kuantan in Kuantan, Pahang, Malaysia. Registration for the race is currently open, so interested runners can sign up ahead of the event date.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Pahang Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Pahang Marathon 2026 offers two distance options for participants: a full marathon covering 42.195 kilometers and a half marathon covering 21.1 kilometers. This allows runners of different experience levels and training backgrounds to choose the distance that best suits their goals.

faqs.question: Where is the Pahang Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Pahang Marathon 2026 takes place at Dataran Sayangi Kuantan, located in Kuantan, Pahang, Malaysia. This venue serves as the central location for the race on September 6, 2026, hosting both the full marathon and half marathon distances offered at the event.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Pahang Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Pahang Marathon 2026 is organized by Persatuan Orang Muda Pahang KL (POMPKL) and Kita Pelari Malaysia, working in partnership with Pure Events. Together, these organizations are responsible for coordinating the race, which is set to be held in Kuantan, Pahang, Malaysia.
